headword: フランス{料理|りょうり}

definitions.explanation: The culinary tradition of France, considered one of the world's great cuisines and known for elaborate technique and refined presentation.

examples.japanese: {誕生日|たんじょうび}にフランス{料理|りょうり}を{食|た}べに{行|い}った。
examples.english: We went to eat French cuisine for my birthday.

examples.japanese: あのレストランはフランス{料理|りょうり}で{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: That restaurant is famous for its French cuisine.

examples.japanese: フランス{料理|りょうり}のフルコースは{前菜|ぜんさい}からデザートまで{何品|なんしな}も{出|で}るので、ゆっくり{時間|じかん}をかけて{楽|たの}しむものだ。
examples.english: A full course of French cuisine includes many dishes from appetizer to dessert, so it is meant to be enjoyed slowly over time.

notes:
French cuisine is widely regarded in Japan as sophisticated and special-occasion dining. It was introduced to Japan during the Meiji era and has deeply influenced {洋食|ようしょく} (Western-style Japanese cooking).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フランス{料理|りょうり}のレストラン: French restaurant
- フランス{料理|りょうり}のフルコース: full-course French meal
- フランス{料理|りょうり}のシェフ: French cuisine chef
- {本格的|ほんかくてき}なフランス{料理|りょうり}: authentic French cuisine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {洋食|ようしょく}: Western-style food — broader category including Japanese adaptations of Western dishes
- {和食|わしょく}: Japanese cuisine — the traditional counterpart
- {中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}: Chinese cuisine
- {イタリア料理|りょうり}: Italian cuisine
